paras: Barboza's leaf-toed gecko (Hemidactylus bayonii) is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Angola.
The specific name, bayonii, is in honor of Portuguese naturalist Francisco Antonio Pinheiro Bayão, who was a planter and administrator in Angola.
The preferred natural habitat of H. bayonii is shrubland, at altitudes from sea level to 900 m (3,000 ft).
Small for its genus, H. bayonii may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of about 3.5 cm (1.4 in).
